cases.rcaSummary: no exactly-one governed read_image row on the live model surface: read the imgov lane request (body.tools[]) against the mount lines in the host log (grep placement-feed / "a5-plane: placed"); a native-shape row means the governed mount never took the name, two rows means a placement conflict that did not fail closed, and no line at all means the fs family never mounted in this session.
